chamfer_policy: Clamp each case to [0,0.01], use 0.01 for invalid, then average; score = 1 - CD / 0.01.
cost_policy: Saved list-price equivalent for four selected generations per UID; full task USD = USD/UID * 100. No retries/Judge/local evaluation. Kimi is the retained tokenizer estimate.
dataset_graphs: Keep complete dataset diagrams and statistics unchanged; the distribution files here describe only the evaluation subset.
invalid_policy: Retain selected original outcomes and fixed denominator; do not infer a new failure taxonomy.
iou_aggregation: Observed valid IoU mean times common metric-success count divided by evaluation N, matching the saved AAAI table implementation.
per_case_policy: Per-case Geometry uses four diagnostic terms. Aggregate Geometry retains the original metric-first statistics; all primitive metric policies are unchanged.
selection: ordered first 100 UIDs of the existing ranked Text400 list; no new sampling
text_score: 100 * mean(descriptive Judge, parametric Geometry, parametric Judge); Topology reported separately.
